name: Logit-based Root Finding (L-Tracing)
definition: A method to find the intersection distance $d$ of a ray with an implicit surface defined by a neural network outputting logits. It uses a coarse sampling grid to locate sign changes in the logit function, then refines the intersection using the secant method. It handles the specific convention where logits are positive outside the surface and negative inside (opposite to standard DVR).
summary: L-Tracing is a root-finding method that determines ray-surface intersections by combining coarse grid search with secant refinement, distinguished by its specific handling of neural network logits and cost-matrix-based sign-change detection.
